dedupe_keys.name: poultry population data complementing the annual report on the epidemiological analyses of avian influenza in the european union latvia

description: Latvia’s Agricultural Data Center publishes poultry-population inputs accompanying EFSA’s avian-influenza analysis. The November 2025 Zenodo deposit is free under CC BY 4.0 and lists an archived workbook labelled AI2024. Its metadata identifies 2023 and 2024 reporting contributions and links EFSA’s SIGMA animal-population guidance. That guidance defines establishment and subunit reporting, but the deposited workbook’s retained geographic detail was not independently inspected. The data can provide baseline populations for agricultural disease-disruption and food-supply resilience simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this national extraction. The archive is not itself a disease-outbreak time series, a farm-movement network or a complete food-supply chain. Exact reference dates, species categories, anonymisation and missing-record treatment remain unknown. The workbook was not opened, and the linked reporting standard does not prove that every optional field is present in the published file.
